name: Unassigned-primary human /commit-and-push (Loop 2)
goal: Add a human-only /commit-and-push lane for an unassigned primary checkout - commit the staged tree exactly onto the current branch, then push it to its own origin ref ff-only via force-with-lease, one intent, no envelope.
